body.intent: Fix A run resumed after a reboot can wait forever on a session that already finished: text references' run 01M6K32AED9M0G432791PNBS8B was resumed by the daemon at 18:35 on 2026-11-04 after the VM reboot, logged 'continuing visit 1' and then nothing for 2+ hours, while its fixer session b0eafd65 shows Status: done at 18:27 (from hook) and its Rex block no longer exists. On resume, re-read each in-flight session's recorded status and judge sessions already done or exited (and treat a missing Rex block as exited) instead of polling a pane that is gone
